metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Like Clueless, this is a quintessential high school satire that is both funny and deeply influential in pop culture.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A sharp, witty teen comedy that mirrors the smart dialogue and charming lead performance found in 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Matches the aesthetic and uplifting, lighthearted energy of Clueless while being an empowering feel-good story.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A perfect blend of whimsical fantasy and romance that captures the magical charm of Practical Magic and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: Like the Jumanji sequels, this uses a video game premise to deliver high-energy action and lighthearted comedy.
